# iosxe_vrrp (Data Source)

This data source can read the VRRP configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "iosxe_vrrp" "example" {
  type     = "Vlan"
  name     = "123"
  group_id = 1
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (Number) VRRP group number
- `name` (String)
- `type` (String) Interface type

### Optional

- `device` (String) A device name from the provider configuration.

### Read-Only

- `address_primary` (Boolean) Mark address as primary IPv4 address
- `address_primary_address` (String) Virtual primary IPv4 address
- `description` (String) Group description
- `id` (String) The path of the retrieved object.
- `preempt_delay_minimum` (Number) Seconds to delay before preempting
- `priority` (Number) Priority level
- `secondary_addresses` (Attributes List) Secondary virtual IPv4 addresses (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--secondary_addresses))
- `shutdown` (Boolean) Shutdown the VRRP group
- `timers_advertise` (Number) Advertisement interval in milliseconds

<a id="nestedatt--secondary_addresses"></a>
### Nested Schema for `secondary_addresses`

Read-Only:

- `address` (String) Secondary IPv4 address
- `secondary` (Boolean) Mark address as secondary
